page_title: MAL 0-0 ALA | Mallorca v Alaves 03/12/2023, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+9' There will be no more action in this match as the referee signals full time.
90+7' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Manu Morlanes (Mallorca) was quite harsh and Jorge Figueroa Vazquez didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
90+7' The corner is swung in but Alaves can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.
90+6' Martin Valjent (Mallorca) pulls the shirt of his opponent and only escapes without punishment due to the benevolence of the referee. A free kick has been awarded to Alaves.
90+5' One of the players from Mallorca times his run too early and the referee blows his whistle for offside.
90+3' The attendance is 15090.
90+2' Jorge Figueroa Vazquez interrupts the game for a tactical foul by Carlos Benavidez (Alaves). There is a free kick near the sideline to Mallorca.
90' 6 additional min. will be played.
86' Substitution. Amath Ndiaye is replaced by Javier Llabres (Mallorca).
86' Ruben Duarte (Alaves) requires medical treatment, so the referee stops play and signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
83' Luis Garcia Plaza has decided to make a change. Carlos Benavidez (Alaves) replaces Ander Guevara.
83' Here's the change. Samu Omorodion leaves the pitch and Kike Garcia (Alaves) comes on as a substitute.
81' The resulting set piece from Mallorca is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.
80' Amath Ndiaye (Mallorca) fails to find any of his teammates inside the box as his pass is blocked. The ball goes out of play and Mallorca have been awarded a corner kick.
80' Mallorca can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.
76' Substitution. Giovanni Alessandro Gonzalez Apud makes his way off the pitch and Pablo Maffeo (Mallorca) comes on as his replacement.
76' Toni Lato (Mallorca) sends a long ball across the pitch, but it misses its target.
75' Luis Garcia Plaza has decided to substitute Jon Guridi and he is replaced by Ianis Hagi (Alaves).
75' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Ruben Duarte (Alaves) will replace Luis Rioja.
74' Sergi Darder (Mallorca) fires a shot at goal from a very promising position outside the penalty area, but it is blocked by a self-sacrificing defender.
73' The game is interrupted now, Manu Morlanes (Mallorca) picks up a knock and the physio has to come on.
72' Jorge Figueroa Vazquez shows a yellow card to Abdelkebir Abqar (Alaves), who isn't surprised as the tackle was really hard and late.
70' Sergi Darder (Mallorca) holds his opponent to prevent him from getting the ball and the referee blows for a foul after seeing the whole situation.
67' Substitution. Abderrahmane Rebbach makes way for Alex Sola (Alaves).
67' Javier Aguirre has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Manu Morlanes (Mallorca) replacing Samu Costa.
67' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Toni Lato (Mallorca) is coming onto the pitch as Jaume Costa cannot continue after picking up an injury.

64' Samu Costa (Mallorca) commits a foul on his opponent and it looks like it should be the other way around at first glance, but the referee makes the right decision in awarding a free kick to the other team.

61' Cyle Larin (Mallorca) must feel embarrassed now. He received a killer pass, but his shot from the six-yard box was a disaster. He miskicked and made it very easy for Antonio Sivera to get hold of the ball.
60' Sergi Darder (Mallorca) is about to take a corner kick.
60' A mistake by a defender gifts Cyle Larin (Mallorca) a chance inside the box, but his wild effort goes well wide of the right post.
53' Antonio Raillo (Mallorca) pulls the jersey of one of the opposition players and Jorge Figueroa Vazquez blows his whistle for a foul.
51' A player from Alaves takes his opponent down, the referee blows his whistle for a foul.
49' Sergi Darder (Mallorca) is obviously very disappointed with his shot from the rebound. He aims exactly at the goalkeeper's gloves. This should have been an easy goal!
48' Samu Costa (Mallorca) sends a pass into the box, but his attempt is thwarted and cleared.
46' Jorge Figueroa Vazquez shows a yellow card to Samu Costa (Mallorca) for a tough tackle.
46' Javier Aguirre has decided to make a substitution during the half-time break. Cyle Larin comes on the pitch for Antonio Sanchez (Mallorca).
46' The referee blows his whistle to signal the start of the second half.
45+3' Jorge Figueroa Vazquez has ended the first half by blowing the whistle.
45+1' Mallorca have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.

45+1' Amath Ndiaye (Mallorca) decides to strike the ball towards goal, but his effort fails to threaten the goalkeeper after being blocked by one of the defenders. The ball goes out for a corner. Mallorca can continue in their attacking effort.
45' 2 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
43' The Mallorca players are exchanging some short passes.
41' Abdon Prats (Mallorca) is down injured and the referee stops play so that he can receive medical treatment.
39' Jorge Figueroa Vazquez blows his whistle as Abdelkebir Abqar (Alaves) used excessive force in the tackle during an attack.
39' Alaves earn a corner.
38' Abderrahmane Rebbach (Alaves) sends the ball into the box from the side of the pitch, but his cross is blocked. Corner kick. Alaves will have an opportunity.
38' Samu Costa (Mallorca) is penalised for holding. Jorge Figueroa Vazquez signals a set piece.
36' Amath Ndiaye (Mallorca) is given a yellow card.
36' Antonio Sanchez (Mallorca) did his best to latch on to a crossfield pass, but it was too long and it goes out of play.
34' Jon Guridi (Alaves) is clearly asking for some medical attention with his painful gestures. The extent of his injury is yet to be discovered.
32' Sergi Darder (Mallorca) serves up a nice cross, but the defence clears the danger.
31' Andoni Gorosabel (Alaves) hits a first-time shot from the edge of the box low towards the middle of the goal, but Predrag Rajkovic is equal to the task and makes a comfortable save.
27' Ander Guevara (Alaves) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Jorge Figueroa Vazquez had an easy-decision to make.
27' A direct free kick from a promising position, taken by Luis Rioja (Alaves), is struck into one of the defending players who deals with the threat.
27' Antonio Raillo (Mallorca) commits an ugly tackle on his opponent, but there is no caution from the referee. Alaves have a free kick.
24' Jorge Figueroa Vazquez shows a yellow card to Antonio Sanchez (Mallorca) for his blatant foul.
22' A pass from Luis Rioja (Alaves) is intercepted by Predrag Rajkovic and the move breaks down.
20' Mallorca failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.
18' The referee and one of his assistants signal for a corner kick to Alaves.
18' Luis Rioja (Alaves) shoots from the edge of the penalty area. The ball travels towards the target, but Predrag Rajkovic easily deals with the threat.
13' Javi Lopez (Alaves) brings an opponent down and Jorge Figueroa Vazquez interrupts the game.
9' Alaves take a short corner instead of sending the ball into the penalty area.

7' Abderrahmane Rebbach (Alaves) finds himself free inside the box and pulls the trigger, but his effort is brilliantly stopped by one of the defending players. The ball goes out of play. Alaves are awarded a corner kick.
6' Jorge Figueroa Vazquez interrupts the game. One of the players from Mallorca won the ball, but his effort is adjudged unfair.
5' Mallorca enjoy a period of possession as they are exchanging some passes and waiting for an opportunity to strike.
2' Abderrahmane Rebbach (Alaves) was too forceful with his tackle and Jorge Figueroa Vazquez interrupted the game to signal a free kick.
